Row.Text: Nearly every market in the known world has Carthaginian traders; Carthaginian guilds negotiate for safe passage, and Carthaginian customs bring profits back to Carthage. This creates resentment. Carthage’s neighbors’ complaints grow louder by the day.
Mercantile power is political power. Tighten the screws.
Soldiers have a way of smoothing deals out.

The Carthaginians – the real Carthaginians – are those merchant families that rule from behind gated compounds. But now, the heir to the Hannonid fortune has had the insolence to fall in love with a commoner. The entire dynasty, perhaps the entire power structure rests on the decisions of one fickle heart.
Strange connections are innovative. Allow the youth to marry.
